verified_facts.text: The hotel sits on the shores of Lake Geneva in Lausanne.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our setting on the shores of Lake Geneva in Lausanne is a natural idyll where lake meets mountains.

verified_facts.text: Beau-Rivage Palace opened in 1861 as a grand hotel on the Quais d'Ouchy in Lausanne.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 1861, a grand hotel on the Quais d’Ouchy opened its doors and ushered in a new era of luxury in Lausanne.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has four restaurants and two bars.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stir your senses in one of our four restaurants and two bars.

verified_facts.text: Kaigan serves Japanese cuisine prepared with authentic Japanese techniques, from sushi to teppanyaki, with sake.
verified_facts.excerpt: prepared with authentic Japanese techniques, from sushis to Teppanyaki, served with precision, honoured with a glass of sake.

verified_facts.text: Cafe Beau-Rivage serves brasserie classics, with an outdoor terrace looking onto the lake.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take a seat at our scenic outdoor terrace to gaze on the lake or settle into the splendour of our dining room to enjoy brasserie classics

verified_facts.text: La Terrasse serves a breakfast buffet with views of Lake Geneva.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rise and shine with a gourmet breakfast buffet of fresh, nourishing dishes, all served with front-row views of legendary Lake Geneva.

verified_facts.text: The Guerlain Spa covers 1,500 square metres.
verified_facts.excerpt: Across 1,500 square metres, the spa brings together one elegant suite for two

verified_facts.text: The spa has heated indoor and outdoor pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: a hairdressing studio, as well as heated indoor and outdoor pools.

verified_facts.text: The spa's changing areas include a hammam, sauna, ice cave and ice fountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: two changing areas with hammam, sauna, ice cave and ice fountain

verified_facts.text: The private Suite Orchidee Imperiale in the spa has a Japanese bath for two and a private hammam.
verified_facts.excerpt: In this private space, you’ll find a Japanese bath for two, private hammam, massage tables and a welcome glass of champagne.

verified_facts.text: Guerlain created an exclusive Beau-Rivage Palace fragrance for the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the exclusive Beau-Rivage Palace Fragrance created by Guerlain for the hotel

verified_facts.text: Palace Junior Suites open onto balconies at the front of the hotel with views of Lake Geneva.
verified_facts.excerpt: our Palace Junior Suites spill out onto showstopping, hotel-front balconies

verified_facts.text: The Imperial Suite has one of the largest private hotel terraces in Switzerland.
verified_facts.excerpt: With one of the largest private hotel terraces in Switzerland, this majestic suite offers entrancing views of Lake Geneva and the Alps

verified_facts.text: The Spa Suite has its own private Guerlain spa with hammam, steam shower and hot tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: a private Guerlain spa with hammam, a steam shower, a hot tub and massage area

verified_facts.text: The Panoramic Suite has a roof terrace with views of Ouchy, the lakefront and the Alps.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ascending to a roof terrace for gazing at the stars, this stylish pad offers giddy views of Ouchy, the lakefront and the Alps.

verified_facts.text: Rooms in the Palace Wing were redesigned by Pierre-Yves Rochon between 2012 and 2014.
verified_facts.excerpt: the “Palace Wing,” whose rooms were redesigned by none other than Pierre-Yves Rochon between 2012 and 2014

verified_facts.text: La Rotonde, a dome, connects the two halves of the building.
verified_facts.excerpt: the magnificent dome—La Rotonde, now the connecting feature between two halves of the building

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a 45-minute drive from Geneva International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: 45 minutes’ drive from Geneva International Airport

verified_facts.text: The Lavaux vineyards are a 15-minute drive away.
verified_facts.excerpt: 15 minutes’ drive from the vineyards and scenery of Lavaux

verified_facts.text: Sister properties Hotel Angleterre and Chateau d'Ouchy are a few minutes' stroll away, each with their own restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just a short walk away from Beau-Rivage Palace you’ll find our sister properties Hôtel Angleterre and Château d’Ouchy, each with their own delicious eating and drinking experiences to savour.

verified_facts.text: Guests can go paddleboarding on the lake.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ease into your stay, whether escape is a day’s paddleboarding or treatments in the Guerlain spa.

verified_facts.text: In 2026 the hotel received a score of 100/100 in the Falstaff Hotel Guide.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 2026, the Beau-Rivage Palace received a score of 100/100 in the Falstaff Hotel Guide.
